sourceText.he: מַתְנִי׳ פָּחוֹת מִבֶּן חֹדֶשׁ נִידָּר, אֲבָל לֹא נֶעֱרָךְ.

positions.claim: a child under one month old is נידר — one may vow his market assessment — but not נערך, since no fixed valuation applies to him
positions.basis: the Torah fixes no ערך for anyone under one month (supplied by the biur, no verse locus in the packet)
